Ramayana: Part 1 is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language epic mythological film directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan. [1]

**Key points from the sources:**
- It is the first instalment of a two-part film series, with Part 1 being based on the first three kāṇḍa (chapters) of Ramayana, which chronicle the life of Prince Rama from childhood up to his adventurous 14-year exile. [1]
- The project was announced in May 2017 as a live-action adaptation of Valmiki's Ramayana, initially conceived as a trilogy by producers; following several years of development and script refinement, it was restructured as a two-part film series under Tiwari's sole direction. [1]
- Produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, the film is based on the Hindu epic Ramayana by Valmiki. [1]
- The first part features an ensemble cast that includes Ranbir Kapoor, Yash (in his Hindi film debut), Sai Pallavi, Ravi Dubey (in his film debut), Anupam Kher, Lara Dutta, Shobana, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Arun Govil, Adinath Kothare. [1]
- He wrote several popular works in Sanskrit, Awadhi, and Braj Bhasha, but is best known as the author of the Hanuman Chalisa and of the epic Ramcharitmanas, a retelling of the Sanskrit Ramayana, based on Rama's life, in the vernacular Awadhi language. [2]

The Moon is the only natural satellite of Earth. [1]

**Key points from the sources:**
- The Moon and Earth are bound by gravitational attraction, which is stronger on the sides facing each other. [1]
- The resulting tidal forces are the main driver of Earth's tides, and have pulled the Moon to always face Earth with the same near side. [1]
- This tidal locking effectively synchronizes the Moon's rotation period (lunar day) to its orbital period (lunar month). [1]
